name: snippen-doorman-service-python
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y gh docker.io bluez && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.gemini && sudo usermod -aG docker vscode && sudo usermod -aG dialout vscode && python3 -m venv /home/vscode/.venv && /home/vscode/.venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev]" && (if [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ]; then DOCKER_GID=$(stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock); sudo groupmod -g $DOCKER_GID docker || sudo groupadd -g $DOCKER_GID docker-host || true; sudo usermod -aG $DOCKER_GID vscode || sudo usermod -aG docker-host vscode || true; sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock || true; fi)
